inputs: native actuator position reference and its history
existing kp/kv and motor force bounds
experimental_opening_compliance.force_semantics: For negative position error only, kp is scaled by 1-(1-floor)*alpha. kv*(vref-v) and original two-sided force limits remain unchanged.
experimental_opening_compliance.filter: Exact two cascaded first-order filters; direction latch holds through zero command increments.

limitations: One known seed. Compliance affects both arms throughout opening motions; no equal-prefix or isolated-release intervention claim. State-only; no RGB training data. Native extrema are simulation diagnostics, not calibrated hardware thresholds.
